title: Our First Conversation
subtitle: The Night I Stayed Awake For Her
quote: Sometimes, a simple conversation becomes the beginning of an unforgettable journey.
endQuote: Some people enter your life with grand speeches. Others enter with a simple message. Grace entered my life with three simple words... 'Anna, syllabus please.' Looking back today, I smile because I never knew that one small message would become the beginning of the most beautiful conversation of my life.

content.text: After that magical evening, life slowly returned to normal.
But deep inside, there was one face that quietly remained in my heart.
Although we had never spoken to each other, I still remembered the moment she turned around when Bhagavath called her name.
I had met hundreds of people in college.
Our Instagram follow requests had already been accepted, but neither of us had started a conversation.
Maybe both of us were waiting for the right moment.
One evening, my friend Lalith invited me to attend an event organized by the Kannada Association.
I wasn't planning to go at first.
That decision became another beautiful turning point in my life.
Students laughed, clicked pictures, and enjoyed every performance.
The entire atmosphere was filled with happiness.
While I was talking with Lalith, my eyes suddenly noticed someone familiar.
She was standing with her friends, smiling and enjoying the event.
Without realizing it, I smiled too.
He looked at me and asked with a mischievous smile,
Before I could even react, Lalith walked straight towards Grace.
As we reached her, Lalith smiled and said,

content.speaker: Lalith
content.text: Grace... this is Hari, my senior.
It was just a simple greeting.
For the next few minutes, all of us stood together and talked about random things.
Just casual conversations about college, classes, and campus life.
It was the first time I had actually spoken to the girl who had unknowingly occupied a small corner of my heart.
As the conversation continued, Lalith suddenly said,

content.speaker: Lalith
content.text: Hari knows almost everything in ECE. If you have any doubts, ask him. He'll definitely help you.

content.speaker: Hari
content.text: Yes... if you ever have any doubts, just ask me. I'll help.
At that moment, I believed she was studying B.Tech like everyone else.
A few minutes later, we all returned to our hostels.
I thought the day had ended.
But destiny still had one more surprise waiting for me.
The sender's name made my heart skip a beat.
I simply stared at the screen.
It was the first message I had ever received from her.

content.speaker: Grace
content.text: Anna... can you please send me the syllabus?
It was such a simple message.
Without wasting any time, I replied,
As I searched for the syllabus, I noticed something unexpected.
I opened the subjects one by one.
I had absolutely no idea about her subjects.
For a few seconds, I wondered...
"How am I supposed to help her?"
Then another thought came into my mind.
"If I say I'll help... I should help."
And spent hours understanding topics that I had never studied before.
Not because it was my responsibility.
For the first time... helping someone genuinely made me happy.
The next morning, I sent her everything I had prepared.
A few minutes later, my phone buzzed again.
Those three words made all the sleepless hours feel worth it.
Our conversations slowly became more frequent.
Neither of us realized it then...
"Anna... can you send me the syllabus?"
—had quietly become the first page of a story that would one day change both our lives.
